title: I’m making a volleyball game where you develop your team and call the plays
author: Glittering-Work3378
selftext:
Hi everyone! This is Jerry, who has no game development experience at all. (But with vibe coding we are capable of achieving impossible things, haha.)

I’m developing Rally Club, a 3D volleyball game built around player development, team building, and tactical decisions.

You take the role of a coach: choose your squad, develop your players, and lead them through a league season. During matches, your players handle movement and positioning, while you make key decisions about how the team plays.

Here’s what you can do:

\- Develop your players: Earn experience, improve their abilities, and unlock skills to suit different roles and playstyles.

\- Build your lineup: Choose players for each position and experiment with combinations that bring out their strengths.

\- Call the plays: Pick serve targets, choose attacking combinations, aim your spikes, and decide which attacker to focus on when blocking.

\- Manage the match: Make substitutions, manage stamina, and adjust your approach as you learn how your opponent plays.

The idea is to make your decisions matter beyond a single rally. A good pass gives you more attacking options. Repeatedly relying on your strongest hitter costs stamina. Developing another attacker could give your team more options in a close match.

I’ve loved volleyball since the 2008 Beijing Olympics, and my favorite player is Wei Qiuyue (a wonderful Chinese female setter, who has won the gold medal in 2016 Rio OG!). I wanted a volleyball game where I could develop a squad over time and explore different tactics, so I decided to make one.

The game is still in development. This video includes a short introduction followed by the trailer, so you can see how it looks and plays.

I will upload and release the game on Steam. But I do wanna know what’s one tactic or player-development feature you’d want to see in a volleyball game? I’d love to hear what matters to you as a player.
